title: Home
description: Café Provence — classic French country cuisine in Prairie Village, Kansas. Family owned and operated by the Quillec family for more than 20 years. Lunch and dinner Monday–Saturday; reservations recommended.

blocks.eyebrow: Prairie Village · family owned for more than 20 years
blocks.heading: Bienvenue! Classic French country cuisine, made with care.
blocks.subheading: We work with local farmers, butchers, and artisanal food purveyors to create distinct, delicious, comforting food that combines the culinary resources of the Midwest with classic French tradition.

blocks.heading: Lunch, dinner, and the nights we're known for

items.title: Lunch — Monday to Saturday, 11:00–2:30
items.desc: Soupe à l'Oignon, Quiche Lorraine, Crêpe au Poulet, Chèvre Chaud, Niçoise, Moules Marinières.

items.title: Dinner — Monday to Saturday from 5:00
items.desc: Magret de Canard, Sole de Douvres Meunière, Carré d'Agneau Rôti, Filet Mignon Sauce Bordelaise, Ravioli de Homard.

items.title: Tuesday Prix Fixe
items.desc: A seasonally inspired four-course prix fixe dinner, offered every Tuesday night, as availability lasts.

items.title: Monday Night Soufflé
items.desc: Our famous French dessert soufflé special — the perfect sweet note to start your week.

items.title: Dessert & Les Cafés
items.desc: Crème Brûlée, Tarte Tatin, Bombe en Chocolat, La Fromagerie, and four coffees — Provence, Parisian, Hot French Nut, Millionaire.

items.text: One of the best meals I have ever had in my life was at Cafe Provence.
Thoughtfully prepared, flavorful, and clearly made with care.
Small, quaint setting. Fantastic service. Great food!
It's like being in Paris. Nice friendly staff make you feel comfortable. Only restaurant that I'll order French onion soup because no other restaurant comes close to their taste.

blocks.heading: Reservations recommended.
blocks.text: Lunch and dinner Monday through Saturday, closed Sunday. Reserve on OpenTable, or call and we'll find you a table.
